hints.title: Thirty-Two Bit Reversal Mirroring
hints.text: Reversing thirty-two bits mirrors each bit index i to index thirty-one minus i. How can shifting bits bit-by-bit assemble the reversed value?

hints.title: Shift and Accumulate Invariant
hints.text: Extract the least significant bit with bitwise-and 1, shift the result left, and shift the input right thirty-two times.

hints.title: Bit Extraction and Insertion Procedure
hints.text: Initialize result to 0. Run a loop 32 times: shift result left by one, add n bitwise-and 1, and shift n right by one. Return the unsigned 32-bit result.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input array length or bit count
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to binary strings incurs heap allocations and string parsing overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise shift and mask operations reverse thirty-two bits in exactly 32 steps with O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle unsigned 32-bit shifting correctly, especially in JavaScript (using >>>) and Java.
